blocks.text: Grammy-award winning British singer-songwriter Olivia Dean will be leading the LaLaLa Fest Manila 2027 lineup, along with Filipino acts BINI, Lola Amour, Up Dharma Down and more. The roster of performers for the event set to be held on Jan. 14, 2027 was announced by concert promoter Wilbros Live through its social media pages on Wednesday, Oct. 7. “So Easy To Fall In Love at LALALA,” it said, referencing Dean’s hit song. “We’ve met in August. See you in January 2027!” “The rumors are true, OLIVIA DEAN is finally coming to MANILA and headlining #LALALA2027,” it exclaimed. Also joining Dean, the […]...
